candidates.name: Commercial Bathwares, LLC
candidates.partition_evidence: The homepage says it supplies and installs commercial restroom products, including toilet and urinal partitions in powder-coated steel, HDPE, phenolic and stainless steel. It says its installers are licensed, insured and union. The seven project photos on the homepage have no captions.
red_flags: No email listed, contact form only
No reviews shown on the site
candidates.reason: A St. Louis-based commercial restroom specialist that supplies and installs toilet partitions. It serves St. Louis, Columbia MO, Springfield IL and the surrounding region.

license.name: Commercial Bathwares, LLC
license.registry: City of St. Louis License Collector, Business License Search (current-year graduated business licenses, updated nightly)
license.license_type: City of St. Louis graduated business license; business type listed as "Other Business Services" (not a contract construction category)
license.note: Searched 2026-11-19 for "Commercial Bathwares" and "Bathware". Both returned 1 match: "Commercial Bathwares Lc", business type "Other Business Services", with an address in the City of St. Louis. The search lists only currently licensed businesses for the current year. No license number is shown. The listed category is not the building or carpentry contractor category, so whether this license covers installation work should be confirmed with the License Collector at (314) 622-4528.

candidates.name: MJ Products Inc
candidates.partition_evidence: The project gallery shows many toilet partition installations: Bobrick Sierra ceiling-hung, Global phenolic, Bobrick plastic laminate and stainless steel partitions. The site describes the company as a distributor and installer, with local installation in St. Louis.
red_flags: A family-owned distributor since 1964 that also ships nationwide, so it competes directly with Next Partitions (high buy-around risk)
candidates.reason: Confirmed commercial toilet partition installer with local installation in St. Louis. It is also a direct partition distributor, so it is a strong installer but a competitor.

license.name: MJ Products Inc
license.registry: City of St. Louis License Collector, Business License Search (current-year graduated business licenses, updated nightly)
license.license_type: City of St. Louis graduated business license; business type listed as "Wholesale Trade"
license.note: Searched 2026-11-19. "MJ Products", "MJ Prod", "M.J. Products" and "MJP" found nothing. "M J Products" returned 1 match: "M J Products Co", business type "Wholesale Trade". The website domain is mjproductsco.com, so this is likely the same company, but the registry record does not confirm it is the Fenton entity "MJ Products Inc". The category is wholesale, not contract construction. Fenton is in St. Louis County, outside the city, and a city license matters only for work inside the City of St. Louis. Confirm the match and the license scope with the License Collector at (314) 622-4528.
